description: This file defines an interface 'MessageInterface' for HTTP message objects, outlining methods for managing protocol version, headers, and message body, emphasizing immutability.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP protocol version as a string.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Return an instance with the specified HTTP protocol version, preserving immutability.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all message header values as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header exists by the given case-insensitive name.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a message header value(s) by the given case-insensitive name.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Retrieves a comma-separated string of the values for a single header.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided header set, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header appended with the given value(s).

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Gets the message body as a stream.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified message body.
